newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: FCC unit gets extra S$18.2 mln land rebate.
newsitem.headline: FCC unit gets extra S$18.2 mln land rebate.

text.p: Property group First Capital Corp (FCC) said on Wednesday its 80 percent-owned unit Fasidon Holdings had been awarded a further Singapore $18.2 million as compensation for the compulsory acquisition of a property in Woodlands Road, Singapore.
The company said in a statement the new award brought to more than S$144 million the total compensation for the property.
FCC made a provision for a loss of S$47.5 million (before minority interests of 20 percent) for the acquisition in its results for the financial year ended June 30, 1996.

"As a result of the settlement now reached, the sum of S$18.2 million (before minority interest) will be brought back to the FCC group's profit and loss accounts for the current financial year," it said.
It said its group earnings per share at the end of the last financial year would have been 55.2 cents instead of 49.1 cents if the award had been made before the year-end.
